jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide dates)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide dates for all participating NSW employers: applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027, offers from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027 and must be accepted/declined by 1:00pm Thu 9 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Law Society lists two closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, both 11:59pm) that vary by employer, and eligibility is generally penultimate-year students.

jobs.program: Graduate Program 2027 (NSW graduate recruitment, market offers)
jobs.notes: Open to final-year students; market-offer applications open 9:00am Mon 22 February 2027 and close 11:59pm Sun 4 April 2027, with interviews from Tue 27 April 2027 and offers able to be made from 9:00am Wed 2 June 2027.
Ten-week Sydney programme designed for penultimate-year law students, with dates aligned to the Law Society of NSW 2027 cycle (opens 9:00am AEST 9 June 2027, closes 11 July 2027).

The firm's careers page confirms applications are currently closed and will reopen in June 2027 for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but no exact open or close date is published yet, so both are null.
